The announcement was followed by an emergency parliamentary session, while no confirmed Saudi request for Egyptian military help or parliamentary authorization had been reported in the consulted sources.

stories.summary: On October 18, St. Petersburg experienced significant fires following a large-scale drone attack from Ukraine, which targeted industrial and logistics facilities. Russian officials stated that 126 drones were intercepted in the surrounding area.

stories.title: Tragic School Shooting in Oregon Leaves Four Dead, Two Injured
stories.summary: A school shooting in Bend, Oregon, resulted in the deaths of four individuals, including three children aged 5, 8, and 11, and a teacher. The shooter, a 16-year-old former student, was stopped by another teacher and an armed community member. Two survivors remain hospitalized as the community mourns the tragic event.

story_report.summary: Four people — three children and a teacher — were killed when a 16-year-old former student opened fire in a special education classroom. Two survivors were hospitalized. The district closed schools to students through October 20, with students scheduled to return October 21, while Silver Rail Elementary will remain closed until further notice. Authorities are investigating the shooting and the suspect's access to a weapon and ammunition.

stories.title: Katie Zacharia Resigns as White House Press Secretary After Five Days
stories.summary: Katie Zacharia has announced that she did not pass the bar exam, despite previously describing herself as a lawyer. Following her brief tenure as White House press secretary, which lasted less than a week, she is transitioning out of her role amid media scrutiny regarding her qualifications. Reports indicate that Trump advised her to reconsider her position.

story_report.summary: Katie Zacharia is transitioning out of the White House press secretary role less than five days after taking it, according to ABC News and other reports.
